name: Figurine of Wondrous Power, Obsidian Steed

text.plain: A Figurine of Wondrous Power is a pocket-sized statuette that becomes its specified living creature when thrown to the ground with a Magic action. This polished obsidian horse can become a Nightmare for up to 24 hours. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 5 days have passed, and each use carries the figurine's printed 10 percent disobedience risk.
